result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, despite being controlled by traffic lights. The surrounding industrial land use and wide, unmarked roadway create a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate where pedestrians should cross the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated signals for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and signalized control with pedestrian signals. However, the environment lacks traffic calming measures like curb extensions, and parked vehicles near the crossing may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the left side of the image may block the sight lines of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area could present a tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground within the crosswalk markings

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment is compromised by parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the crossing and a lack of traffic control or signage to manage vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk on both sides of the street block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides at the intersection

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The crossing lacks traffic signals, stop signs, or pedestrian warning signs, which may lead to high vehicle speeds and failure to yield.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian exposure distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install signage to alert drivers of the pedestrian crossing and reinforce yielding requirements.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and paved sidewalks. However, the environment lacks physical traffic calming measures and is characterized by wide asphalt surfaces and the presence of heavy commercial vehicles.

hazards.name: Heavy Vehicle Traffic
hazards.description: A large commercial truck is approaching the intersection, which increases risk due to significant blind spots and vehicle mass.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway approaching the crosswalk

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street may obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway beyond the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, which also helps to naturally calm traffic.
